Dear Mr. Hewett:
From April 10 through May 4, 2023, representatives of the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials
Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Pipeline Safety (OPS), along with representatives
from the Michigan Public Service Commission, Minnesota Office of Pipeline Safety, and the
Iowa Utility Board acting as Interstate Agents, pursuant to Chapter 601 of 49 United States Code
(U.S.C.), inspected Northern Natural Gas Company’s (NNG) procedures and records for class
location in Omaha, Nebraska.
As a result of the inspection, it is alleged that you have committed a probable violation of the
Pipeline Safety Regulations, Title 49, Code of Federal Regulations (CFR). The item inspected
and the probable violation is:
